question: For what duration must the practice be done so that old age and death are destroyed?
premises: The practice is done for one year.
When it has been practiced for one year, a condition is met.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The exact practice referred to is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
